title: English Practice Quiz 0805
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Inventory and Procurement 01: A purchase requisition is used to:
options: Request approval to obtain goods or services
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Request approval to obtain goods or services. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Inventory and Procurement 02: A goods received note confirms:
options: Items delivered and checked against the order
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Items delivered and checked against the order. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Inventory and Procurement 03: FIFO stock rotation means:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: First In, First Out. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Inventory and Procurement 04: A stock discrepancy should be:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Checked, documented and reported. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Inventory and Procurement 05: A purchase order normally states:
options: Items, quantities, prices and agreed terms
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Items, quantities, prices and agreed terms. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Inventory and Procurement 06: Competitive quotations help an organisation:
options: Compare price, quality and service terms
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Compare price, quality and service terms. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Inventory and Procurement 07: A reorder level indicates:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: When stock should be replenished. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Inventory and Procurement 08: An invoice should be checked against:
options: The purchase order and receipt records
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: The purchase order and receipt records. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Inventory and Procurement 09: Damaged goods should be:
options: Recorded and handled through the returns or claims process
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Recorded and handled through the returns or claims process. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Inventory and Procurement 10: Segregation of duties in purchasing helps:
options: Reduce errors and opportunities for fraud
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Reduce errors and opportunities for fraud. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.
